Class AdminCLI

java.lang.Object
lms.presentation.AdminCLI
All Implemented Interfaces:
CLI
public class AdminCLI extends Object implements CLI
Administrator command-line interface for the Library Management System.

Provides administrators with functionality to manage library items (books, CDs, journals), user accounts, loans, and view system reports. Uses ServiceContext to simplify dependency injection.

Version:
3.1
Author:
Majd Awwad
